_sText:
Dark Sakura ported straight from Fate/unlimited codes!!!

Features:
  • Dynamic Bones for her hair and the least amount of clipping I could manage!
  • Fully voiced with voicelines taken straight from the fighting game!!
  • Two (2) different colour palettes to choose from!!!
  • A custom spray of an image of a slightly stretched Fate/tiger colosseum sprite that made me laugh for some reason!!!!
  • The sickest Kouhai you've ever seen!!!!!

She is the first of hopefully a bunch of F/uc characters that will be ported into BRC as I'm (plus a very helpful friend of mine) very slowly figuring out how to get the rest of them to work so hopefully you can expect those within in the next few weeks!!

Key Authors: dealing with the manmade hell that is Unity
basically everything in Blender, could not have done this without them!! (they also already ported both Shirou and Rin so you should 200% check those out too ^_^)
